name: YMB Fuel youth business accelerator
city: Atlanta, GA (some parts may be online)
what_you_do: If you already run a small business, join a one-week summer camp with coaching, mentors and a Pitch Day for cash grants. It is free. The company does not take any share of your business.
who_can_apply: Young business owners ages 11 to 17. You have a product or service, you have paying customers and you want to grow.
pay_detail: Free to join. Grants are given at Pitch Day; the amounts are not listed.
deadline_text: No deadline or cohort dates are posted on the page.
how_to_apply: Click Apply now on the YMB Fuel page. Applications are reviewed, then there is a shortlist and interviews. You must commit to attend.
notes: Also open to younger kids. Your business needs paying customers already. For newer ideas the site lists YMB Spark (early-stage help) but its page was not read. YMB also holds an annual Summit (two days, ages 11 to 17 can register); dates and cost were not on the page.
